### InfiniBand — Live Topology (Fabric Map)
[**NVIS Home**](/d/nvis-home) · [IB Fabric Home](/d/nvis-l2-ib-fabric) · [Switches — Quantum-3 Fleet](/d/nvis-ib-switches) · [Rail State & Cabling](/d/nvis-ib-cable-audit)

### What this board shows

The **identity view** of the InfiniBand fabric: the switch inventory and the point-to-point link map built by the `ib-identity` sweep (`ib_switch_info`, `ib_link_peer`, `ib_node_placement`), the per-switch reachability reported by `ib-switch-live` and `ib-lldp`, and the UFM controller's own port and cable state.

**Producer status.** All of those collectors are stopped at the moment, so these tiles read no value. They are left exactly as they are and will repopulate on their own when the exporters are restarted — see *IB / UFM collector endpoint reachability* on the [IB Fabric Home](/d/nvis-l2-ib-fabric).

**Live alternatives right now:** switch reachability, health and firmware for the Quantum-3 fleet are on [Switches — Quantum-3 Fleet](/d/nvis-ib-switches); the host side of every link — rail state, errors and throughput — is on [Rail State & Cabling Audit](/d/nvis-ib-cable-audit) and [Port Errors](/d/nvis-ib-drops).
